old_caption: The video showcases two clear plastic containers placed side by side against a dark background. Each container is marked with a green strip of paper, which appears to be a pH indicator strip, commonly used to measure the acidity or alkalinity of a solution. The left container holds a clear liquid, likely water, with some bubbles visible on the surface, suggesting recent stirring or agitation. The right container contains a murky, cloudy liquid, possibly a mixture of water and soil or sediment, with several large, irregularly shaped stones submerged at the bottom. The stones vary in color from light brown to grayish tones. The pH indicator strips in both containers show a consistent color change, indicating a similar level of acidity or alkalinity. There is no significant movement or change in the scene throughout the video; it focuses on the static display of the containers and their contents.

caption: The video showcases two transparent plastic cups standing side by side against a dark backdrop featuring a soft, blurry orange-red glow centered between them. Each cup has a vertical green paper strip fixed to its front face, marked with a short horizontal dark ink line at roughly the same height. The left cup contains a clear liquid filled to the level of the ink mark on its left side, along with a crinkled transparent plastic liner. The right cup holds a clear liquid with a surface below the ink mark, containing a transparent plastic liner that encases two oval, mottled green-brown fruit pieces, with additional crinkled plastic or ice-like material visible near the rim. Throughout the excerpt, the cups, green strips, ink marks, liquid surfaces, and fruit pieces remain fixed in position, showing no measurable translation, expansion, or deformation. The background glow and cup outlines stay stationary, indicating no camera movement, while only negligible shimmer or refraction variations occur within the transparent liners and liquid.
